documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 818.7 crores, representing a 54.8% year-on-year growth, alongside PAT of INR 39.5 crores. Sales volume for the quarter grew 10% year-on-year to 577 kgs, while H1 FY27 volume reached 968 kgs. Management highlighted plans to set up a wholly-owned subsidiary focused on lightweight jewellery, silver, platinum, and lab-grown diamonds, primarily targeting online B2C channels. Furthermore, the company is focusing on scaling its corporate retail chain business share from 51% to 65% to accelerate cash flow turnaround cycles. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported a 58.7% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹1,367.15 crore for H1 FY27.

guidance.claim: The company targets scaling its corporate client business share from 51% to 65%.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: Management expects production to ramp up in the coming quarters following capacity addition.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall demand environment remains encouraging due to the ongoing festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary designs, and affordable products continues to generate market opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's recent entry into the bridal jewellery segment has received encouraging traction.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also happy to share that our entry into Bridal jewellery segment has received encouraging traction.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue grew by 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail expansion plans of corporate clients are anticipated to drive additional product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: Bridal wear represents the second-largest expense in Indian weddings, with bridal jewellery accounting for the highest share at 23-25% of total wedding costs.
demand_outlook.quote: Bridal wear is the second-largest expense in Indian Weddings, with bridal jewellery accounting for the highest share at 23-25% of total INR in Billion wedding costs

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand its presence across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to set up the new subsidiary with an initial minimal outlay of up to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We can, but for this, we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to expand its manufacturing capacity to support growth in the bridal segment.
capex_expansion.quote: To further strengthen this position, we intend to expand our manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately ₹15 crore through internal accruals for capacity expansion and machinery upgrades.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Branch offices were opened in Delhi and Pune to expand operations.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 68 crores, up 53.1% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter at INR68 crores, an increase of 53.1% Y-0-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY27 reached INR 54.9 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased following capacity expansion from 2.5 to 4 tonnes and associated headcount growth.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: PAT increased by 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore in H1 FY27 with a margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 14.6%.
EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was reported at 12.4%.
PAT margin for Q1 FY27 was recorded at 8.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 FY27 sales volume reached 577 kgs, representing a 10% year-on-year increase.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently maintains an inventory of approximately 400 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: Approximately 400 kgs is our inventory, 400 kgs.

orders_capacity.claim: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed on February 23, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates an integrated manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of 4,000 kg p.a.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

orders_capacity.claim: Actual capacity utilization for the year was 87% considering a blended capacity for the full year of 2,625 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow management is currently management's top operational priority.
capital_allocation.quote: Limited cash flow management is our top priority today.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains its overall inventory hedge in the range of 30% to 35%.
capital_allocation.quote: Thus, we maintain a hedge in the range of 30% to 35%.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash outflow improved to -₹77.91 crore in H1 FY27 from -₹412.11 crore in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: The company secured gold loan facilities from two private banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Secured gold loan facilities from two private banks, leveraging our deposits to earn a positive yield from one of these banks.

capital_allocation.claim: The listing of the company enabled growth funds.
capital_allocation.quote: Listing of the company enabled growth funds

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty have rendered consumers more cautious in their spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations require substantial working capital and liquidity to sustain multi-location business expansion.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting to scale its business share from corporate clients from 51% to 65%.
management_commitments.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

management_commitments.claim: Production will ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to seize opportunities to enter into different gold jewellery segments.
management_commitments.quote: Will continue to seize opportunities to enter into different gold jewellery segments

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
